prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A modern, minimalist home gym setting with cool, muted lighting. The focal point is a large, vertically oriented smart fitness mirror with a sleek black frame, positioned against a wall of frosted glass panels. Reflected in the mirror is a life-sized, high-definition digital trainer: a fit man wearing a bright blue sleeveless athletic shirt, white knee sleeves, black shorts, and white sneakers. He stands confidently on a dark exercise mat, gesturing with both hands as if explaining or motivating, his expression focused and encouraging. The digital interface displays workout metrics and icons in clean, white graphics, adding a futuristic, high-tech feel. In the foreground, partially silhouetted, is the torso and arm of a person standing with hands on hips, observing the trainer. The composition uses a shallow depth of field, drawing attention to the mirror and its contents, while the ambient light creates soft reflections and a calm, aspirational mood. The overall style is cinematic and contemporary, evoking themes of technology, self-improvement, and modern living.
